content: Supabase RLS multi-tenant mistakes: comparing auth.uid() (user id) directly to tenant_id instead of joining through a membership/profiles table or JWT custom claim; skipping RLS during prototyping and forgetting to enable before launch; exposing service_role key client-side; testing policies in SQL Editor which bypasses RLS instead of via client SDK; missing indexes on columns referenced in RLS policies causing severe perf degradation at scale.
